youtube_description:
Jesus... why do I hate every photo of myself? 😔 Bible verse for self-worth.

Her: Jesus... why do I hate every photo of myself? 😔

Her: My friend posted one tonight. I made her delete it.

Jesus: I saw you zoom in on your face, looking for something wrong.

Her: Because something is wrong. I'm not pretty like them.

Jesus: You've compared yourself to filters so long, your real face feels like a mistake. It isn't.

"For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation."
Psalm 149:4 (BSB)
